pages.title: Repeating Code
pages.content: A `while` loop repeats a block of code as long as its condition is `True`. Be careful — if the condition never becomes False, you'll get an infinite loop!

pages.title: While Loop
pages.code:
count = 1

while count <= 5:
    print(count)
    count += 1  # Don't forget this!

print("Done!")

pages.title: Quick Check
pages.question: When does a while loop stop?
options: When it reaches a return statement
pages.explanation: A while loop continues as long as the condition is True and stops when it becomes False.
